title: Renewal Fee of a Lapsed Northgate Membership
content:
**Rule.** The renewal fee of a lapsed membership of Northgate Memberships is the annual fee of the tier the new membership year is held at, charged once for the new membership year, never below zero and kept to the cent.

**The tier the new membership year is held at.**

1. The new membership year is held at the Northgate Club Membership, the tier a Student Club or Heroes Club renewal converts to, whose annual fee is 65.00 dollars, when either:
   - (a) the membership is a Student Club or Heroes Club membership whose status verification on record is not valid on the first day of the new membership year; or
   - (b) the membership is a Student Club membership that has already paid as many Student Club membership years as its discounted term limit.
2. It is held at the base tier named as the downgrade target when the membership is a Plus tier with a confirmed downgrade at renewal request; the fee is then that base tier's annual fee.
3. It is held at the tier the membership already has in every other case.

**Terms used.**

- *First day of the new membership year.* The day after the lapsed expiry date when the renewal keeps the anniversary — the renewal fee being paid no later than the tier's anniversary period, in calendar months, after the lapsed expiry date (calendar months added to the expiry date; where the resulting month has no such day, the boundary is that month's last day) — and the payment date when it does not.
- *Verification valid on the first day.* The date through which the status verification is valid, as shown on the membership, is that first day or later.
- *Student Club membership years paid.* The Student Club membership years a Student Club membership has paid are counted as its new membership and renewal fee charges less every charge that was refunded as a duplicate charge.
- *Discounted term limit.* The tier's maximum number of consecutive membership years at the discounted tier.
- *Confirmed downgrade at renewal request.* A downgrade-at-renewal request on the membership whose status is confirmed.

## Worked cases (hypothetical memberships)

| Membership | Facts | Tier held | Renewal fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Student Club, verification valid through 31 August 2027 | expiry 30 June 2027; paid 20 July 2027, inside the 1-month anniversary period, so the year starts 1 July 2027; 4 Student Club years paid against a limit of 4 | Northgate Club Membership | 65.00 |
| Heroes Club, verification valid through 10 March 2027 | expiry 28 February 2027; paid 15 March 2027, inside the 2-month period; year starts 1 March 2027; verification valid on that day | Northgate Heroes Club Membership | that tier's annual fee |
| Heroes Club, verification valid through 10 March 2027 | expiry 31 December 2026; paid 15 March 2027, after the 28 February 2027 boundary; year starts 15 March 2027; verification not valid on that day | Northgate Club Membership | 65.00 |
| Club Plus with a confirmed downgrade at renewal request | expired; renewed | Northgate Club Membership (its downgrade target) | the Club annual fee |
| Business, nothing else applies | expired; renewed | Northgate Business Membership | that tier's annual fee |

The amount is taken to the cent and charged once for the new year.
